2609.11335.title: On the Impact of Anonymization on the Performance of Large Language Models
2609.11335.paper_summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains, anonymizing input data to protect personally identifiable information has become a critical practice. However, the impact of this anonymization on model utility is not well understood. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of the trade-off between privacy and performance. We evaluate five prominent language models across eleven diverse benchmarks, comparing their performance on original versus pseudonymized inputs. Our results reveal that while anonymization generally degrades performance, the effect is highly nuanced. We find that more capable models, such as Qwen2.5-72B and GPT-4o mini, suffer the largest performance drops, suggesting a stronger reliance on specific entity information. The impact is also task-dependent: performance on TruthfulQA improves with anonymization, while retrieval-focused tasks like RGB experience a catastrophic decline. Further experiments show that reversible anonymization techniques that preserve entity uniqueness significantly outperform irreversible ones like redaction, and that explicitly prompting models about anonymization offers no discernible benefit. We conclude that anonymization is not a one-size-fits-all solution and must be co-designed with the model and task in mind to balance privacy and utility effectively. Our findings provide a crucial baseline for developing more robust, privacy-aware AI systems.
2609.11335.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型在敏感領域的日益應用，對輸入數據進行匿名化以保護個人可識別信息已成為一項重要的實踐。<lb/>然而，這種匿名化對模型效用的影響尚不清楚。<lb/>本文呈現了一項系統的實證研究，探討隱私與性能之間的權衡。<lb/>我們評估了五個著名的語言模型在十一個多樣化基準上的表現，並比較了它們在原始輸入與偽名化輸入上的性能。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，雖然匿名化通常會降低性能，但其影響非常微妙。<lb/>我們發現，像 Qwen2.5-72B 和 GPT-4o mini 這樣更強大的模型，其性能下降幅度最大，這表明它們對特定實體信息的依賴更強。<lb/>這一影響也是依賴於任務的：在 TruthfulQA 上，性能隨著匿名化而改善，而像 RGB 這樣以檢索為重點的任務則經歷了災難性的下降。<lb/>進一步的實驗顯示，保留實體唯一性的可逆匿名化技術顯著優於不可逆的技術，如刪除，並且明確提示模型有關匿名化並未帶來明顯的好處。<lb/>我們得出結論，匿名化並不是一種通用的解決方案，必須與模型和任務共同設計，以有效平衡隱私和效用。<lb/>我們的研究結果為開發更強大、注重隱私的 AI 系統提供了重要的基準。
